rows.en: Perhaps you are what they call the Anima Spiritia...
rows.notes: anima supirichia = Anima Spiritia (Macross 7); not in the glossary. Ends on a trailing 'ga'; kept as trailing.

rows.en: Um, would you mind going shopping with me after this?
Are you truly up to this?
Just try not to get in the operation's way.
You must succeed at an operation this simple.
Are you really fit to sortie?
This operation looks set to give you a little trouble.
This'll be tough, with skills like yours.
Operation start. I am counting on you.
Operation start. I'm praying for your success.
You will heed my instructions.
The operation's starting. Don't let your guard down.
Are you quite ready? The operation is starting!
I'm expecting great results from you.
I am counting on you as the linchpin of this operation.
You'll be fine. Go out there with confidence.
With your skill, there should be no problem.
I'm relying on your skill.
I am praying for your success.
The success of this operation rests on you. Do your best.
rows.notes: seihin 'product' heard for seihi 'success or failure'.

rows.en: With you, I can give my instructions with peace of mind.
Be sure to come back. Promise me.
This operation should present no problems whatsoever.
Don't do anything reckless and worry me too much, okay?
There is nothing to worry about. I am counting on you.
I'm sorry. I keep relying on you for everything.
As I thought, the Meltrandi cannot be trusted.
rows.notes: Low-rating result line; 'Merutoran' kept as heard (Meltrandi, glossary). Odd line for any player; the transcript may be wrong.

rows.en: Stop fooling around and get back here!
That was quite an ordeal.
I'm amazed you made it back.
Well, well. It seems the fleet commander's chair has slipped further away again.
Succeeding at an operation like this is a given, isn't it?
I am very glad you have come back safely.
Operation successful. Good work.
It seems the operation was a success.
You did well. Keep it up next time too.
I am counting on you next time as well.
Good work. The operation's a success.
You seem to be in rather fine form.
Keep this up in the next operation too.
Results like these are beyond my expectations.
We succeeded thanks to you.
Splendid skill!
Splendid results. Impressive.
Even I have come to feel what they call Culture.
rows.notes: bunka = Culture, capitalised as Zentradi speech (glossary).

rows.en: Hurry back! If we don't hurry, the sale will be over!
Somehow this old fellow feels rather embarrassed.
rows.notes: ojisan: he calls himself an old man.

rows.en: I'm just happy you came back safely.
Oh! Deculture!
Honestly, I was worried about you!
Our operation time is limited. Would you complete the mission promptly?
rows.notes: Transcript joins the sentences with 'masu ga'; read as two sentences.

rows.en: Operation time is limited. Carry out the mission promptly.
Would you bring the operation to a swift end?
Finish the operation quickly.
There is ample time left for the operation.
There's plenty of time left for the operation.
Half the operation time has elapsed.
Half the operation time has elapsed.
Time is running short.
Not much time left!
There seems to be very little time left.
Only a little time left!
3 minutes left.
3 minutes left.
2 minutes left.
2 minutes left.
1 minute left.
1 minute left.
30 seconds left.
30 seconds left.
10 seconds left.
10 seconds left.
5 seconds
5 seconds
4 seconds
4 seconds

rows.notes: Heard as 'sayounara'; the countdown slot is 'san' (3), as for every other operator.
